_comment: GitHub Issues profile. ${ID}/${BODY}/${LABEL}/${STATUS} are interpolated by the caller, ${REPO} by ct render from vcs.VCS_REPO_SLUG. Requires the `gh` CLI, authenticated. Board (Projects v2) commands need the `project` scope on the token — if it is absent, TRACKER_SET_STATUS calls fail with INSUFFICIENT_SCOPES and the pipeline is expected to skip board moves rather than abort.

tracker.TRACKER_LOCK_MECHANISM: an `agent:*` label on the issue — labels are atomic server-side, so adding one is the mutex acquire

notes: The agent mutex is a label because GitHub labels are set server-side atomically; two racing agents cannot both observe an absent label and both add it without one of them seeing the other's on re-read. The workflow rule 'acquire BEFORE moving status' exists because the picker filters on (actionable status AND no agent:* label) — moving status first opens a race window.

Projects v2 status moves require a token with the `project` scope. Pipelines that run with a default Actions token should treat board moves as best-effort and never fail a step on INSUFFICIENT_SCOPES.
